inventory.notes: One donkey with red reading glasses, tan bridle (browband, cheek strap, noseband, brass ring) and chest harness with girth and three buckles; one easel with one blank canvas; one brass junction box with three cables pink/teal/violet running to three racks; one teal lead clipped to harness ring. No text, logos or extras.

orientation.notes: Donkey in profile facing right toward canvas; canvas face turned three-quarters to camera, blank; racks face camera with lights and patch loops; glasses sit on the muzzle right way up.

contact.notes: Four legs: three hooves on the ground shadow, one front hoof raised and empty; easel three legs on ground; cables droop on the floor and enter rack ports and junction box sockets; lead clips to brass ring. Glasses temple runs back to the cheek buckle rather than the ear base: minor, accepted. Light is even pencil, no unexplained glow.
